description: Run a scheduled rule on demand, bypassing its cron cooldown. Only works on enabled scheduled rules. Dispatches the rule's actions immediately and honours its execution mode (Propose drafts, Autopilot executes, Observe no-ops); the preview says which. Does NOT advance the cron schedule. The commit returns the dispatch count, run ids, and any handler message. Requires Write + automation.execute; company rules need the Admin role and an operator (unpinned) credential.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: run_rule_now
title: Run Rule Now
